root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from a race condition in the io_uring/zcrx subsystem where io_zcrx_put_niov_uref() performs a non-atomic read-then-decrement on the user_refs counter, allowing io_zcrx_scrub() to concurrently modify it via atomic_xchg without lock serialization, leading to reference count corruption and double-free errors.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states io_zcrx_put_niov_uref() uses a "non-atomic check-then-decrement pattern (atomic_read followed by separate atomic_dec)" while io_zcrx_scrub() modifies the same counter with "atomic_xchg() WITHOUT holding rq_lock," causing the same niov to be pushed to the freelist twice ("DOUBLE-FREE") as illustrated in the SMP race diagram.
